name: Gralic Caelune
keeps: the two hashes, and the disagreement between them
does: Replays the chain from nothing and says whether the balance is the sum of the events. Signs when it is.
text: Gralic caelune of the cold store, keeps the book for the 12th tranche, doors 105 to 114. Keeps the two hashes, and the disagreement between them. Reads Bodhidharma.
